newSystematicPatterns.recommendation: TV_FILM_PATTERNS at scripts/audit-wrong-production.js:148-154 still over-flag despite isScreenAdaptedShow() fallback. Consider extending fallback list further (e.g., a-bronx-tale, the-mountaintop, the-wedding-singer, three-days-of-rain — these all reference TV/film as critical context). Better: add a strict-context guard requiring proximity to clearly-TV phrases like "this season of", "Episode N", "streaming service" to flag, OR move TV_FILM_PATTERNS to MEDIUM severity by default for reviews scored by reputable Broadway-focused outlets (NYT, Variety, etc.).
